udp_ip_rx.summary: UDP receive parser: an FSM accepts an IP header plus byte payload stream, extracts the 8-byte UDP header via a byte pointer into header registers, then forwards length-checked payload through a skid-buffered AXI stream.

blocks.name: Parser FSM
blocks.description: Sequences header acceptance, byte-wise UDP header extraction, payload transfer and frame termination

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Parser FSM: idle, read UDP header, read payload, last-word, wait-last

anchors.name: hdr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: UDP header byte index selecting which field byte to store

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload byte count; detects length mismatch and last word

anchors.name: store_ip_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable for all IP/Ethernet header holding registers

anchors.name: store_udp_source_port_0
anchors.why: Per-byte UDP header field load enable decoded from hdr_ptr

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Load enable for last_word_data_reg

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready asserted in idle when output header slot free

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input payload ready from FSM and output skid buffer readiness

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output UDP header valid after all 8 header bytes stored

blocks.name: Header registers
blocks.description: Hold IP/Ethernet header fields and extracted UDP ports, length, checksum

anchors.name: m_udp_source_port_reg
anchors.why: UDP header field registers loaded byte-wise from payload stream

anchors.name: m_udp_length_reg
anchors.why: UDP length field; initializes payload word counter

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Latched Ethernet/IP header fields passed through to output

blocks.name: Payload datapath
blocks.description: Passes payload bytes to internal stream, holding last byte when trimming padding

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: IP payload byte stream; source of UDP header bytes and payload

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload byte valid advancing header pointer and payload transfer

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Frame end marker; triggers early-termination errors and return to idle

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds last payload byte while discarding padding until tlast

blocks.name: Output skid buffer
blocks.description: Two-register skid buffer driving the output UDP payload AXI stream

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer output data register

anchors.name: temp_m_udp_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register when output stalls

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready steering skid buffer transfers

anchors.name: store_udp_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Skid buffer load-to-output enable

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output UDP payload byte stream from skid buffer

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready controlling skid buffer and early ready

blocks.name: Status outputs
blocks.description: Busy and early-termination error indications

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy when FSM not idle

anchors.name: error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: Error: frame ended inside UDP header

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error: payload shorter than UDP length

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input IP header valid starts frame reception

ungrouped_anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
ungrouped_anchors.why: Downstream header ready clears header valid

axis_fifo.summary: AXI-Stream FIFO: write logic stores packed beats into a RAM via write/commit pointers, a read pipeline fetches via rd pointer to the output port, with full/empty compare and depth/overflow status.

blocks.name: Write controller
blocks.description: Accepts input beats, writes mem, manages commit pointer and frame drop/mark logic.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem, incremented on accepted input beats.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_commit_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer; frames become visible to reader once committed, used for empty.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready derived from full and drop/mark mode parameters.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: Pointer MSB compare; deasserts s_axis_tready and triggers drop/mark.

anchors.name: full_wr
anchors.why: Frame overflow flag (frame mode only) forcing drop or send of oversize frame.

anchors.name: drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Set while discarding the current frame; parameter-disabled in this config.

anchors.name: mark_frame_reg
anchors.why: Marks truncated frame bad via tlast/tuser override when full.

anchors.name: send_frame_reg
anchors.why: Forces commit of oversize frame beats in frame mode.

anchors.name: s_frame_reg
anchors.why: Tracks being inside an input frame for mark-when-full.

anchors.name: s_axis
anchors.why: Packed input word (data, tlast, tuser) written into mem.

blocks.name: FIFO RAM
blocks.description: Dual-pointer RAM storing packed stream beats.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Main FIFO RAM holding packed tdata/tlast/tuser beats.

blocks.name: Read pipeline
blocks.description: Reads mem through RAM pipeline registers and drives the output stream handshake.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer addressing mem, incremented when a beat enters the output pipeline.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: Commit pointer equals read pointer; blocks read pointer increment.

anchors.name: m_axis_pipe_reg
anchors.why: RAM read pipeline stages carrying beats from mem to the output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Valid chain for the read pipeline stages; bubbles allow advance.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_pipe
anchors.why: Ready into the read pipeline enabling stage transfers and reads.

anchors.name: m_axis
anchors.why: Packed output word from last pipeline stage unpacked into fields.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream payload from last RAM pipeline stage.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid driven from valid pipeline, optionally gated by pause.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready advancing the output pipeline and read pointer.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-frame unpacked from stored beat.

blocks.name: Status
blocks.description: Registered depth and frame-event status outputs.

anchors.name: status_depth
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy output from registered write-read pointer difference.

anchors.name: status_depth_commit
anchors.why: Committed occupancy output from commit pointer minus read pointer.

anchors.name: status_overflow
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a dropped frame due to overflow.

anchors.name: status_bad_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a dropped bad frame.

anchors.name: status_good_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a committed good frame.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input stream payload packed into s_axis and written to mem.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input valid; with tready triggers writes into mem.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input end-of-frame stored with beat and steering frame tracking.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input user sideband stored with beat, overridden on marked frames.

udp_checksum_gen.summary: UDP checksum generator: an FSM latches header fields, sums pseudo-header and payload bytes while payload streams into an AXIS FIFO, then queues header with length/checksum in a header FIFO.

blocks.name: Checksum FSM
blocks.description: Accepts header, steps header-sum states, sums payload, finishes checksum and requests header FIFO write.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Sequences idle, three header-sum states, payload summing and checksum finish.

anchors.name: store_udp_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable capturing all input header fields into holding registers on header accept.

anchors.name: shift_payload_in
anchors.why: Enables payload stream handshake into payload FIFO during payload summing.

anchors.name: hdr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pulse after checksum finish requesting header FIFO write.

anchors.name: busy_reg
anchors.why: Busy indication while FSM is not idle, drives busy output.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input header valid starting a new frame checksum.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Input header ready in idle when header FIFO has room.

blocks.name: Checksum datapath
blocks.description: Accumulates ones-complement checksum and counts payload bytes for UDP length.

anchors.name: checksum_reg
anchors.why: Ones-complement checksum accumulator over pseudo-header and payload; written into header FIFO.

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Payload byte counter selecting byte lane and giving UDP length stored in header FIFO.

anchors.name: checksum_part
anchors.why: Folded carry sum used to finalize the inverted checksum.

blocks.name: Header holding registers
blocks.description: Latched input header fields used for pseudo-header sum and queued into header FIFO.

anchors.name: ip_source_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched header field held during checksum, summed and queued to header FIFO.

blocks.name: Header FIFO
blocks.description: Per-field memories with wr/rd pointers queuing completed headers with length and checksum.

anchors.name: udp_checksum_mem
anchors.why: Header FIFO storage (representative array) holding computed checksum per frame.

anchors.name: header_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO write pointer addressing all header field memories.

anchors.name: header_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO read pointer addressing header memories for output registers.

anchors.name: header_fifo_write
anchors.why: Header FIFO write strobe when header valid and FIFO not full.

anchors.name: header_fifo_read
anchors.why: Header FIFO read strobe loading output header registers.

anchors.name: header_fifo_full
anchors.why: Header FIFO full; blocks writes and input header ready.

anchors.name: header_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Header FIFO empty; withholds output header valid.

blocks.name: Payload FIFO
blocks.description: AXIS FIFO buffering payload while checksum is computed.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Payload bytes summed into checksum and forwarded to payload FIFO.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload stream valid gated into payload FIFO.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready from FIFO gated by shift_payload_in.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of payload, moves FSM to checksum finish.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload stream from payload FIFO.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from payload FIFO.

blocks.name: Output header interface
blocks.description: Presents queued header fields with computed length and checksum on output handshake.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid when a header entry is read from header FIFO.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Output header ready advancing the header FIFO read.

anchors.name: m_udp_checksum
anchors.why: Computed UDP checksum output from header FIFO.

anchors.name: m_udp_length
anchors.why: Computed UDP length output from header FIFO.

anchors.name: m_ip_length
anchors.why: IP length derived as UDP length plus 20.

udp_ip_tx.summary: UDP transmitter: FSM latches parallel UDP/IP header, serializes 8-byte UDP header then streams payload into IP payload AXI stream through a skid-buffered output.

blocks.name: tx_fsm
blocks.description: Frame FSM driving header acceptance, header serialization and payload pass-through.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM: idle, write header, write payload, payload last, wait last; sequences frame transmission.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy level when FSM not idle.

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error flag when payload tlast arrives before UDP length.

blocks.name: header_latch
blocks.description: Latches parallel Ethernet/IP/UDP header fields on header handshake.

anchors.name: store_udp_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching all input header fields into header registers.

anchors.name: udp_length_reg
anchors.why: Latched UDP length; serialized as header byte and seeds word count.

anchors.name: udp_source_port_reg
anchors.why: Latched UDP source port serialized into header bytes.

anchors.name: m_ip_length_reg
anchors.why: IP length computed as UDP length plus 20, driven on header output.

anchors.name: m_ip_source_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched IP/Ethernet header field passed to output.

blocks.name: header_serializer
blocks.description: Emits 8 UDP header bytes indexed by hdr_ptr before payload.

anchors.name: hdr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header byte pointer selecting which UDP header byte to emit.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal byte mux: header byte, payload byte or last word into output buffer.

blocks.name: payload_counter
blocks.description: Counts remaining payload bytes, holds last word, flags early termination.

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload byte count from UDP length; detects last word and early termination.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds final payload byte until frame tlast arrives.

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Enable capturing last payload word into last_word_data_reg.

blocks.name: output_skid_buffer
blocks.description: Two-register skid buffer on IP payload AXI stream output.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready from skid buffer gating FSM byte emission.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Output skid buffer valid register.

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp register occupied flag; gates internal ready and output refill.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Enable moving internal byte into output register.

blocks.name: udp_input
blocks.description: UDP header handshake and payload AXI stream input.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input header valid; with ready triggers header latch and FSM start.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready from registered FSM output, accepts new UDP header.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input UDP payload stream bytes passed to IP payload output.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload stream valid; drives word transfer and word count decrement.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready from FSM and output skid buffer readiness.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of payload frame; returns FSM to idle and checks length mismatch.

blocks.name: ip_output
blocks.description: IP header and IP payload AXI stream output.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output IP payload byte stream: UDP header bytes then payload.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer output register.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready draining output and temp registers.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output IP header valid, set on header latch, cleared by m_ip_hdr_ready.

udp.summary: UDP stack wrapper: a receive deparser turns IP frames into UDP frames, while an optional checksum generator feeds a transmit framer that wraps UDP frames into IP frames.

blocks.name: UDP receive path
blocks.description: udp_ip_rx extracts UDP header from IP payload and forwards UDP payload.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: IP header input valid into the RX deparser.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: IP payload byte stream entering the RX deparser.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Received UDP header valid output from the RX deparser.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received UDP payload byte stream output.

anchors.name: rx_busy
anchors.why: RX deparser busy indication.

anchors.name: rx_error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: RX error: frame ended before UDP header complete.

blocks.name: Checksum generator
blocks.description: Optional checksum generation buffering payload, producing UDP length and checksum.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: UDP header input valid into checksum generator / TX path.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: UDP payload byte stream entering the TX path.

anchors.name: tx_udp_checksum
anchors.why: Computed UDP checksum passed to the TX framer.

anchors.name: tx_udp_length
anchors.why: UDP length computed by checksum generator for TX framer.

blocks.name: UDP transmit path
blocks.description: udp_ip_tx serializes UDP header onto IP payload stream and emits IP frame.

anchors.name: tx_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Internal header handshake from checksum generator (or bypass) into the TX framer.

anchors.name: tx_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Internal payload stream from checksum FIFO into the TX framer.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Transmitted IP header valid output from the TX framer.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Transmitted IP payload byte stream including serialized UDP header.

anchors.name: tx_busy
anchors.why: TX framer busy indication.
